name: WayriCAD Constraint Studio
description: Visually inspect, stage and review project constraints with protocol presets, matrices and scope feedback.
description_full: Constraint Studio 0.3.1 integrated into WayriCAD: visual rule scope, local lint and changed-file overview, protocol presets, staged rule/netclass/board settings, clearance matrices, reusable sets, offline help and separate review exports. Native DRC runs on exported copies. Source updates use the offline helper after closing source editors. KiCad 10 validation target; broader acceptance remains incomplete.
